run_yaml_gen_for_task: run the script with --task mlp_cifar10 to generate YAML config files for MLP CIFAR-10 experiments
gen_yaml_configs: generate multiple YAML config files from a base template by iterating over a list of variable combinations
gen_single_yaml_config: generate a single YAML config file for a specific experiment with a given set of variable values
grid2list_combinations: convert a grid search structure into a flat list of all possible value combinations
purge_files_by_pattern: purge files from a directory that match a given regex pattern
